name: L1 Norm Regularization for Transfer Functions
aliases: L1 Regularization on Opacity and Color TFs
definition: L1 norm regularization is applied to both opacity and color transfer functions to avoid unnecessary complexity when a simpler TF yields a similar result.
summary: L1 Norm Regularization for Transfer Functions applies an L1 penalty to opacity and color parameters to eliminate unnecessary complexity and improve interpretability, distinguishing itself by targeting transfer functions rather than volumetric density fields.
